info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create P2m Webhook Endpoint-spec
info.description: The P2M Webhook Registration API enables users to create webhook endpoints that facilitate real-time notifications for various events in the P2M ecosystem. This API allows digital service providers to register their endpoints, empowering them to receive timely updates and data changes. Typical consumers include developers integrating with payment systems, transaction tracking, or event-driven architectures. By registering webhook endpoints, businesses can streamline their operations and enhance their response capabilities to user actions or system events.

post.description: This API endpoint allows you to create a new webhook endpoint that can receive events from the server. You will need to specify the necessary configurations to set up the webhook correctly.

requestBody.description: Contains the details and parameters required to create a new webhook endpoint. This includes necessary configuration settings and any relevant identifiers.
